newsitem.title: USA: Substance Abuse completes convertible offer.
newsitem.headline: Substance Abuse completes convertible offer.

text.p: Substance Abuse Technologies Inc said on Monday it completed a $5 million convertible note offering to Stephen Cohen and S.A.C. Capital Associates LLC.
The company said it sold convertible notes for a three-year term at seven percent annual interest convertible at $2 per share subject to adjustment.

It said it also sold Cohen and S.A.C. Capital warrants to buy 2.5 million shares of common stock at $2 per share subject to adjustment. The notes and warrants would not be convertible or exercisable until July 1, 1997, the company said.
